text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, in late October…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I wish to speak with you… about our future plans.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thank you. My apologies for being so abrupt a gust…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Is there any chance we could clear my schedule of races for at least the remainder of the month, and focus on training instead?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship will feature not only Daiichi Ruby, but also the storm-force wind of unknowable potential, Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I wish to focus on preparing for that race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I also have my promise with Teio to fulfill next year—by winning races across three different distances and surpassing the Mile Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'd like to use the time I have now to hone my wind further still.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thank you for being a comforting breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I need more ferocity! More! I must become an even fiercer tempest!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: …Wow. I can feel her determination from here.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Zephyr… You're becoming more and more like the wind.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: The wind…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to be like that again…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's still a soft breeze that's blowing. Let's up the intensity, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr's passion for training is burning red-hot. Let's stick to the plan and refrain from entering any races for now.
